India Extends Anti-Dumping Duties on Imported Papers and Aluminium Products

India has extended anti-dumping duties on decor papers imported from China until March 2027. Additionally, anti-dumping duties on aluminium products may be extended for five years. These measures are aimed at protecting domestic industries from unfair trade practices.
